slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the goal of this plan — minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, or is there another objective (such as meeting a specific target number of tables, or balancing orders across suppliers)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and offered minimize total cost as an option.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier A requires ordering at least 30 tables from Supplier B, nor did it mark this as an assumption.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier B requires also ordering from Supplier C, nor did it mark this as an assumption.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conditional requirement that ordering from Supplier A forces at least 30 tables from Supplier B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional constraint and then stated 'No other constraints' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conditional requirement that ordering from Supplier B implies ordering from Supplier C.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional constraint and then stated 'No other constraints' in its READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 conditional supplier-link constraints H2 and H3 remained unresolved and were silently assumed absent.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the objective and basic bounds, but stopped prematurely after missing both P1 conditional supplier-link constraints, silently assuming no A-to-B minimum or B-to-C ordering requirement.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
